verdict: The probe directly checks production text_loss logits against cached gold-history decoding, including EOS, with a valid CE reconstruction. Tested FP32 arithmetic agrees within declared tolerance; learned target likelihood remains poor. No decisive decoder/shift mismatch in these cases.
answer_leakage_assessment: Gold targets deliberately condition diagnostic teacher forcing only. They are not fed to free generation, whose observation contains only the high prefix; free16 is diagnostic and not official success.
fp32_assessment: model.float plus model/llm embed_dtype and img.dtype_mm cover inspected dtype controls. This tests FP32 arithmetic on the saved BF16-rounded base and FP32 adapters, not original full precision source weights.
limits: Three selected records only, batch size one, protocol stage MEM bypass.
BF16 shape-dependent differences can change near-tied top1; precision agreement does not prove checkpoint provenance or original LM readout suitability.
No proof for all contexts, padding batches, MEM, FAST, motor, or closed-loop success.
Base adapter-off free decoding remains abnormal; poor language decoding pre-existed this protocol fine-tune for tested records.
